start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-a-personalised-explainer-video-on-any-topic-for-a-learner." Turn a topic and a description of one learner (what they know, what they want, how long they will watch) into a finished explainer video: a lesson pitched at that learner, a spoken track, word-exact timing, one consistent animated character whose mouth follows the voice, one picture per spoken line, and a deterministic render.
